reading.text:
UNIT def:LevyStochCalc.Poisson.Compensated.MarkStep.ξ
Standing setting (paper section 2, intro (eq:mvfbsdej), section 3 solution space, section 4,
appendix A): (Omega, F, (F_t), P) satisfying the usual conditions, horizon T > 0; a d-dim
Brownian motion W and an independent Poisson random measure N on R_+ x E with intensity
dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a countably generated (E, calE); (F_t) is the usual augmentation
of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent initial sigma-field F_0. The compensated
measure is Ntilde(dt,de) = N(dt,de) - dt nu(de). Integrands U of the Poisson integral are
predictable: P (x) calE-measurable, P the predictable sigma-field on Omega x [0,T]
(eq:fubiniiso), with E int_0^T ||U_t||^2_{L2(nu)} dt < infinity (the space H^2_N). The
integral int_0^t int_E U_s(e) Ntilde(ds,de) is the standard L2 (Ito-Levy) compensated-Poisson
integral: an L2 martingale, cadlag, with the isometry E|int_0^t int U dNtilde|^2 =
E int_0^t ||U_s||^2 ds (used in Lemma 4.1 "true L2-martingales by the Ito and
compensated-Poisson isometries"), jumps Delta = U_s(e) at atoms (s,e) of N, and for integrands
in L1(dP dt nu) the integral splits as int U dN - int U nu ds (eq:compid, eq:zeromean).
Progressive measurability is used for the coefficient processes b, sigma, f and the forcings
q^b, q^sigma, q^f (eq:coefmeas, section 4); predictability (P (x) calE) for h and q^h.

Reading.
The paper never names a "mark step" object: it uses the compensated integral only through the
standard L2 theory, whose elementary integrands are
  U_s(omega,e) = sum_{i,k} xi_{ik}(omega) 1_{(t_i,t_{i+1}]}(s) 1_{B_k}(e),
with a finite time grid t_0 < ... , each xi_{ik} F_{t_i}-measurable (bounded, or at least
square-integrable), and finitely many mark sets B_k in calE with nu(B_k) < infinity; their
integral is sum_{i,k} xi_{ik} Ntilde((t_i ^ t, t_{i+1} ^ t] x B_k), where
Ntilde(A) = N(A) - (dt x nu)(A) is meaningful only for finite-intensity A. A structure
"MarkStep" (a simple integrand in the mark variable, possibly also in time) is faithful when its
fields jointly encode such an integrand: the time intervals left-open right-closed (predictable),
the coefficients measurable at the left endpoint of their interval (with respect to the
filtration of the setting), the mark cells measurable with finite nu-mass (else Ntilde is not
defined and junk values enter), finitely many cells; and when the evaluation and integral built
from it give the formulas above. This unit is an auxiliary of the construction of the paper
integral; it is faithful if it is a correct component of that construction (the final
stochasticIntegral agreeing with the paper integral), and unfaithful if a junk value or a
missing measurability/finite-mass condition can reach the integral the propositions use.

Specific to the field xi: the coefficient random variables xi_k : Omega -> R (or R^m) of the
pieces. For the step integrand to be predictable, each xi_k must be measurable with respect to
F at the left endpoint of its time interval (the structure, or the predicate using it, must
impose this); for the L2 theory each xi_k must be bounded or square-integrable. If xi is a free
function with these conditions imposed elsewhere (a separate predicate), the field itself is
faithful as "the coefficients".

comparison.text:
Lean (LevyStochCalc/Poisson/MarkStepIsometry.lean): structure MarkStep Omega E nu g (g : TimeGrid,
nu sigma-finite) with fields K : N (number of mark sets), B : Fin K -> Set E, B_measurable,
B_finite : nu (B k) != top, xi : N -> Fin K -> Omega -> R, xi_bounded (each xi i k bounded),
xi_measurable (ambient measurability). eval G s e omega = sum_{i < N0} 1_{(p i, p (i+1)]}(s) *
sum_k xi i k omega 1_{B k}(e). integral N G t omega = sum_{i < N0} sum_k xi i k omega *
N.compensated ((min (p i) t, min (p (i+1)) t] x B k) omega. Adaptedness at the left endpoints
(xi i k strongly measurable for F (p i), i < N0) is the separate predicate MarkStep.Adapted, which
every use in the integral construction carries (master_adapted; martingale_integral needs it).
Comparison with the locked reading: the structure encodes exactly an elementary integrand
sum_{i,k} xi_{ik} 1_{(t_i,t_{i+1}]}(s) 1_{B_k}(e) with finitely many mark cells of finite
nu-mass shared across time pieces (a refinement every step function admits), left-open
right-closed time intervals, bounded measurable coefficients; predictability of the coefficients
is imposed by the separate Adapted predicate (the reading allowed this). Every cell
(a,b] x B_k with 0 <= a <= b and nu(B_k) < infinity has finite intensity (b-a) nu(B_k), so
N.compensated on it is N(cell).toReal - intensity, the paper Ntilde(cell), with a junk value only
on the null set where N(cell) = infinity. The integral formula is the paper elementary integral
up to time t (for t <= p i the cell is empty and contributes 0). No junk reaches the final
integral.
Specific: xi : N -> Fin K -> Omega -> R, the coefficients of piece i and mark set k; boundedness
and ambient measurability are structure fields, F(p i)-measurability is MarkStep.Adapted
(separate predicate, carried by every approximant the integral uses). Coefficients for i >= N0
are irrelevant (eval and integral sum only over i < N0). Matches the reading (the case "free
function with the adaptedness imposed elsewhere").

verdict.detail:
Representation choices: (1) predictability of the coefficients (xi_{ik} F(p_i)-measurable) is the
separate predicate MarkStep.Adapted, not a structure field; every approximant used by the integral
(master) carries it (master_adapted), and the martingale and isometry lemmas take it as a
hypothesis; (2) mark sets B_k are shared across time pieces (any step integrand admits such a
common refinement; the construction obtains it via exists_sharedMark_blockDiag); (3) coefficients
bounded and ambient-measurable (standard for elementary integrands); (4) coefficients for
i >= N0 present but unused.

author_review.disagreements:
Minor, classification only: the author records "faithful"; I record "faithful with
representation choices", listing that predictability of the coefficients is the separate
predicate MarkStep.Adapted (not a structure field), that mark sets are shared across time pieces,
and that coefficients are bounded. These are harmless (every approximant the integral uses is
Adapted); no substantive disagreement.
